verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of mParticle. Every item describes a hosted service you send data to, such as sending events to mParticle or ingesting data from your warehouse into mParticle, and that is not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
